summary: For each successful call of estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, publish the pallet width, height, and depth in metres on the stage-2 outcome and on PalletPoseStamped. Width and height are the factory face that call already matches, params.pallet_width_m 1.20 m and params.pallet_height_m 0.14 m, and the search template stays that face. The face-centre position and yaw stay the pose. Depth is the length of this pallet along the face normal on the side farther from the camera, through the two fork openings the prototype already cuts. Of the points sample_face_points already returned, keep those that, after the plane projection is translated by the opposite of best_pose's tx and ty and rotated by the opposite of the rotation rotate_proto_into applies, fall inside either pocket rectangle: centres at plus and minus pocket_centre_offset_m along the prototype width axis, with sides pocket_width_m and pocket_height_m. A point counts only when its signed point_to_plane_distance is less than the negation of plane_inlier_threshold_m. The camera-facing normal makes that negative side the side farther from the camera, and the point's contribution is the negation of that signed distance. depth_m is the median of those contributions. has_body_depth is true only when that set is non-empty. When the set is empty, has_body_depth is false, publish_pose still publishes the pose with the factory face width and height, and the handling process reads depth_m as a body length only when has_body_depth is true. The fields width_m, height_m, depth_m, and has_body_depth are written on the outcome and, after input_depth_stamp, on PalletPoseStamped. A failed estimate still publishes no PalletPoseStamped. The two early returns in on_pair stay silent. Stage 2 still runs once, on the one candidate select_detection already chooses. The rich message already carries this pair's RGB and depth stamps, so the sizes belong to this capture while the scene can still change. The user named the three sizes. The part they did not name is that depth is the median far-side length through those two pocket openings, and that has_body_depth is false when the openings show no body.
hypothesis: The pose the handling process reads has the face centre and yaw for this synchronized capture, while the factory face and the samples inside its pocket openings stay inside estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2. Writing that face onto the outcome, and the median far-side length of the samples inside those openings, gives the handling process the width, height, and body depth of the pallet this capture is about to approach.
